description:
NSFW button cleanup:

- Add a dedicated NSFW tab in both native bottom-bar implementations; keep Inbox intact.
- Use Reddit's blur-content icon (icon_nsfw), outlined when off and filled when on, with the active highlight.
- Draw the NSFW title and accessibility label explicitly. Place it after Vertical when present, otherwise after Home.
- Remove pending and success toasts. Unavailable settings, rejected updates and timeouts can still show an error.
- Retain NSFW-only/SFW-only filtering, Show NSFW and blur behavior, confirmed-settings refresh, queued taps, and profile/redraw ownership fixes.

Build and ten local JVM checks passed. Emulator testing, full APK test builds, post-release downloads and CI-result polling were skipped at the user's request. Please test the new tab/icon on the phone.

Refresh the existing source in Morphe Manager and repatch Reddit 2026.14.0 with the usual upstream patches.
